SEMANTICS.RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT_means: mechanically retryable condition, NOT authorization to retry
requires_fresh: fresh semantic authorization (principal, operation, typed_target, mutation_scope, contract_hash, intent/candidate fingerprint, approval/Decision basis, expiry)
new bounded lease/attempt with new attempt_id and lease_reference
does_not_automatically: auto-transition to APPLYING merely because state is retryable

REBIND_PLAN.new_journal_creation: fresh retry creates new JournalRecord with new journal_id, new attempt_id, same correlation_id (lineage) plus new authorization_reference/lease_reference and new complete_external_identity; previous journal record preserved as history
REBIND_PLAN.distinction: original attempt/journal history (journal_id lineage via correlation_id) vs new authorized attempt identity (new journal_id/attempt_id with fresh complete identity)
REBIND_PLAN.correlation_lineage: correlation_id chains retries; correlation index allows audit of original vs retry
REBIND_PLAN.no_overwrite: old evidence fields (authorization_reference, candidate_raw_digest of prior attempt) remain immutable
REBIND_PLAN.validation: fresh authorization validated via AuthorityEngine before new PREPARED create; stale preconditions fail closed
